name: IT Helpdesk - Weekly Performance Report

parameters.query: SELECT t.tenant_id, COUNT(*) as total_tickets, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) as closed, COUNT(CASE WHEN t.sla_deadline < NOW() AND t.status != 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) as sla_breached, ROUND(AVG(t.feedback_score),1) as avg_satisfaction, c.channel_id FROM hd_tickets t JOIN hd_managers m ON m.tenant_id = t.tenant_id JOIN hd_report_config c ON c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE t.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.tenant_id, c.channel_id;
